language.title: Language
language.description: Choose the Subversion tool window and operation language. Follow IDE uses OpenIDEA's display language.

panelFontSize.title: Tool window font size (px)
panelFontSize.description: Use 0 to follow OpenIDEA, or choose a size from 10 to 24 px.

diffFontSize.title: Diff preview font size (px)
diffFontSize.description: Use 0 to follow OpenIDEA, or choose a size from 10 to 24 px. Applies to embedded previews and conflict text.
